articles.title: The bitcoin price level where leveraged bulls could get whacked
articles.snippet: Bulls are stacking longs, liquidity is thinning and one key level could trigger large liquidations.

articles.title: Hackers Are Abusing a macOS Screen Sharing Flaw to Secretly Mine Monero
articles.snippet: The Dutch cyber agency says attackers exploited an authentication flaw in macOS Screen Sharing to gain root access and plant Monero miners, with public proof-of-concept code now circulating.

articles.title: SafePal Bitcoin Wallet Data Breach Stokes Fears of Physical Attacks
articles.snippet: A flaw in an order-tracking plug-in of bitcoin wallet provider SafePal exposed names, addresses and phone numbers of nearly 40,000 customers.

articles.title: France Tax Data Leak Could Fuel Scams, Attacks Targeting Bitcoin Holders
articles.snippet: A hacker is reportedly selling personal and financial records tied to more than 678,000 taxpayers and businesses in France.
